verdicts.rationale: Both halves of the hint fail the purpose test. 'Each press fires one bite / not a multi-hit string' describes how the kit works (single-hit normal) — working behavior, which the style guide says to delete, not caveat. The '1.8s cooldown not modelled' concern is already covered: the in-stance N frame value (109 ≈ 1.8s) spaces a bite string ~1.8s apart on the timeline, so there is no visible divergence for a player chaining bites. A normal-ability cooldown is not a wired primitive that would improve on the frame cadence here, so there is nothing decision-relevant to implement or note.
rubricRefs: Corollaries: never describe working behavior — delete it
CAN model: per-swing action events / frame cadence
